title: Thaya taypinkir Susperu
intro: Mä reino ukham amuytʼañäni, ukanjja jan uñjkaña ukat uñjatäki ukanakajj mayachtʼatäpjjänwa, ukat mä reino taypin mä reino nayraqatan saytʼatäsma, ukajj janiw yaqha reinonakjamäkiti. Aka almax jan yatiñan yatiñaniwa, mayninakax amuyapkaspa uka ch’amanakaruw kamachi. Ukhamäkchisa, wali chʼamani jaqenakas mä jiskʼa animalampiw jiskʼachasispa, ukat kunatï cheqäki ukajj horasakamajj imantatäspawa. ¿Khitis aka jaqix herenciapax walja maranakan ist’asi?
clues: Nayarojj mä reino churapjjetäna, nayat qhepatjja janiw khitis uka reinojj utjkaspati.
Mä munat awk taykatwa yatiñanaka ukat yatiñanak katoqawayta.
Thayajj nayan apnaqatäjjänwa, kawkhantï munkayäta ukaruw ordenajar saraskäna.
Kunjamsa jamachʼinakajj parlapjje uk sum amuyayäta, jupanakajj ejercitojanwa servipjjäna.
Mä jisk’a jamach’it yatiyäw katuqta, mä reinax intiruw yupaychäna.
Jiwañajajj imantataw qheparäna, aka oraqen mä animalaw thujrujar manqʼantañkama, ukat ukapachaw jinninakajj jan uñjkañ jan uñtʼapjjatap amuyapjjäna.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
